newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo bourse revises Bovespa index portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo bourse revises Bovespa index portfolio.

text.p: Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said it revised the portfolio of its Bovespa index comprising the most traded shares.

The new portfolio, valid for the next four months, includes 49 most liquid shares. Participation of benchmark Telebras stocks in the portfolio increased, with Telebras preferred representing 43.54 percent of the index and its common share accounting for 3.878 percent.
Previously, Telebras preferred had accounted for 40.431 percent, while the common stock had represented 2.763 percent.
The Sao Paulo bourse revises the Bovespa index portfolio every four months.
